##: Strata Terminal + HIP engine (Windows x64). One release tag (Version, e.g. 0.2.13) carries three lockstep version numbers: the Strata app/release version, the Control runtime version (asset strata-control-<ctrl>, e.g. 0.1.59.1) and the inference engine version (asset strata-engine-<eng>-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna3). This package downloads BOTH the Control runtime (flat, no top-level folder) and the engine tarball (into components\engine\<eng>-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna3) so they always install and update together. pre_install writes bin\strata-hip.cmd exporting STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR / STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND. checkver reads the signed strata-feed.json and returns release+control+engine versions and asset urls/hashes at once; autoupdate rewrites both url[]/hash[] plus extract_to together on the next scoop update.
description: Strata 终端版 + HIP 推理引擎（AMD Radeon RX 7000 / 9000 与 Strix Halo，ROCm 打包在包内）：一条命令装好控制端与引擎，模型文件另存
notes: 引擎与控制端都装在本包目录内（apps\strata-hip\<version>），shim 名称为 strata-hip；不写系统环境变量，也不碰 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Strata 下的其它引擎
版本对应：manifest 的 Version（如 0.2.13）是 Strata 的发布/应用版本；同包内的控制端(control)与 HIP 推理引擎(engine)各自带内部版本（如 0.2.13 = control 0.1.59.1 + engine 0.1.59）。三者随同一发布锁步更新，本清单同时下载控制端与 HIP 引擎，scoop 升级时二者一起换
HIP 变体默认按 RDNA3 打包（gfx1100/1101/1102/1151）：RX 7900 XT/XTX/GRE、RX 7800/7700、RX 9070 之前的 7000 系列与 Strix Halo。RX 6000（gfx1030/1031）或 RX 9070/9070 XT（gfx1200/1201）需要换引擎包，见 README
模型（GGUF）不随包分发：先自行准备模型，再用 start-model-visible.ps1 启动
启动：start-model-visible.ps1 -Backend hip（或直接运行 strata-hip）
pre_install: $c = @('@echo off','setlocal','rem Strata (HIP / AMD Radeon) - Scoop build: the engine lives inside this package.','set "STRATA_COMPONENTS_DIR=%~dp0..\components"','set "STRATA_ENGINE_BACKEND=hip"','call "%~dp0strata.cmd" %*','exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%'); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $dir 'bin') | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'bin\strata-hip.cmd') -Value $c -Encoding Ascii
